navigation.alt: The retained one-day gift-kit review has separate input and report tabs. Forms shows quantity and limits while Decision brief stays selected in Reports.
navigation.caption: Inputs and Reports navigate independently. Forms shows authored fields; YAML exposes the complete case; choosing a tab does not accept an answer or calculate a finding.

reviewStart.alt: The unreviewed gift-kit case opens its decision brief with the next required input review and responsible role.
reviewStart.caption: The decision brief identifies the next required task. Opening it navigates to the input pane without accepting an answer or running an assessment.

observations.alt: The Forms input group displays scoped gift-kit diagnostic records awaiting review, independently of the selected decision brief.
observations.caption: Rehearsal records → Recorded checks groups the source observations in Forms. The current report selection remains intact.

commitment.alt: Quantity and limits in the retained one-day gift-kit review show 120 kits, a 1,440-minute cutoff and the $600 ceiling.
commitment.caption: The input group retains the original 120-kit, one-day and $600 boundaries. Changing navigation does not change those values.

comparisonCost.alt: The retained five-minute teaching review prefers the complete $300 internal correction in the deployed UI.
comparisonCost.caption: The retained teaching release still plans five minutes of rehearsal. Its current assessment shows the focused finding and compact comparison.

evidence.alt: The retained evidence assessment establishes the printed-code and wrong-destination corrections in the current production UI.
evidence.caption: Read the focused evidence finding, then expand its explanation when needed. Accepting that result is a separate review action.

schedule.alt: The requested schedule shows the original five-minute teaching release’s internal correction, rehearsal and handoff at minute 35.
schedule.caption: The requested supporting schedule describes the selected internal arrangement. Return to decision restores the focused comparison.

decisionBrief.alt: The retained reviewed case’s authored brief proposes $300 internal correction and preserves its reviewed basis.
decisionBrief.caption: Decision brief remains a separate report selection. The authored proposal is supported by reviewed findings; it does not establish actual completion.

comparisonEarly.alt: The same retained teaching inputs under earliest-handoff priority prefer the complete $400 external correction.
comparisonEarly.caption: The exact retained earliest-handoff release keeps its original priority and five-minute rehearsal input.

missingConfirmation.alt: The external correction is blocked by its missing confirmation; the retained teaching review supports internal correction at $300.
missingConfirmation.caption: The current finding exposes the missing condition; navigating reports does not supply a booking.

rehearsalBlocked.alt: The separate adapted ten-minute-minimum release blocks complete corrections while the case supplies five minutes.
rehearsalBlocked.caption: The stronger requirement leaves the original five-minute case input untouched. No complete correction passes.

authorFive.alt: The separate adapted ten-minute-minimum release blocks complete corrections while the case supplies five minutes.
authorFive.caption: The stronger requirement leaves the original five-minute case input untouched. No complete correction passes.

revisedDecision.alt: The same adapted release supports the $300 internal correction with ten minutes planned and handoff at minute 40.
revisedDecision.caption: The case now supplies ten minutes under the same stronger requirement. People still authorize and carry out the work.

authorTen.alt: The same adapted release supports the $300 internal correction with ten minutes planned and handoff at minute 40.
authorTen.caption: The case now supplies ten minutes under the same stronger requirement. People still authorize and carry out the work.

revisedBrief.alt: The adapted teaching review’s brief proposes internal correction with a ten-minute rehearsal and minute-40 handoff.
revisedBrief.caption: The accepted evidence is retained. The adapted planning finding and authored proposal reflect ten minutes supplied under the stronger rule.

standaloneDecision.alt: The standalone cost-first teaching app opens its focused Decision report with Supporting reports available beside it.
standaloneDecision.caption: Standalone apps keep Decision and Supporting reports visible. Their selection is independent of the complete-case input representation.
